node.title: XR rank-two dual trades have five exact support profiles
node.statement: For a rank-two dual-product-code trade, each active coordinate is nonzero in all but at most one projectively distinct block row. Double-counting pairwise support intersections excludes pair cap at most three. Under pair cap four it forces 4<=t<=6, 6<=R<=8, and exactly five zero-set profiles: (t,R;z)=(4,6;1^4),(4,7;1,2^3),(4,8;2^4),(5,6;1^5),(6,6;1^6). The row space is a two-dimensional dual-GRS_4 subcode and the row-coefficient space a two-dimensional dual-RS_2 subcode; either inclusion is equality at R=6 or t=4 respectively. Explicit finite-field trades realize all five profiles, so this is a sharp support atlas, not a chart payment.
